name: launcher_ui
title: Launcher UI
description: PAX launcher with SD/USB apps, GitHub Store, LAN discovery and network settings.
author: PAX contributors
about: Browse and launch PAX apps from SD or USB, install apps from the GitHub Store or a local PAX Supply server, and browse Internet Archive collections. Includes themes, backgrounds, favorites, tooltips and network settings with nearby Wi-Fi scanning. Network setup and firmware update controls require compatible PAX host firmware. No external game data is required. Bluetooth settings scan nearby devices and connect supported HID input devices through compatible companion firmware. C6 supports BLE; original ESP32 companions can provide Classic and BLE. Other device profiles require separate integrations.
changelog: 0.7.2: Tighten the compact network and battery status cluster to give the header title more space. 0.7.1 positions the compact title between the left toolbar and right status icons. 0.7.0 reduces list-detail text on narrow canvases.
controls: Touch or mouse: select an app or source
Mouse wheel or arrow keys: scroll lists
Settings: configure network, themes and tooltips
Hold Menu 3 s: return to the firmware launcher

extract.instructions:
No mandatory external game data is needed by this current build.
